title: Headcount sync + interview debrief action items (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for follow-ups after 2/27 headcount sync + interview loop debriefs. Not polished - notes to self and action list.

Summary notes:
- Discussed reprioritization of open reqs: infra (serving/runtime) > product infra > developer tooling. Hiring manager asks: can we move 1 IC from platform infra req to serving-runtime? Tentative yes, subject to budget and approvals.
- Interview loop feedback (3 candidates live this week):
  * C1 (SWE-Infra): strong systems design, worried about gap on CUDA/runtime experience - hiring managers split (Maya leaning yes, Ethan leaning no).
  * C2 (SWE-Serving Runtime): excellent latency/benchmarking experience, team vibes good - recommend hire (can start Q2).
  * C3 (SWE-Platform): ok culture fit, backend solid but not senior-level expected. Consider as IC2 bench.
- We have 2 open headcount slots in plan but need exec approval to convert budget from contractor pool.

Action items (owner - due):
- Follow up with Finance on budget delta and contractor-to-FTE conversion process (Priya) - due 2026-03-05.
- Schedule quick sync with Eng VP to confirm priority shift (Lena + Maya) - target 2026-03-03.
- Draft short justification doc for moving slot from platform->serving-runtime (Lena) - include impact on latency roadmap + SLOs - due 2026-03-04.
- Reach out to C2 with verbal offer + timeline (Ethan) - target 2026-03-02.
- Keep C1 warm while we decide on readiness for CUDA/runtimes (Maya) - send resources & suggested mentorship plan by 2026-03-06.
- Capture interview loop calibration notes and update hiring rubric for serving-runtime role (all interviewers) - collect notes by 2026-03-04.

Open questions / risks:
- Budget approval timeline from Finance might push start dates into late Q2 - escalate if we hear no decision by 2026-03-07.
- If we reassign slot from platform infra, what downstream work gets deprioritized? Need PM input.
- Do we want to expedite an internal transfer option before opening external search? Ask HR about precedence.

Draft agenda for next headcount sync (10 min):
1) Quick state (2 min): open reqs + candidate statuses (Lena)
2) Proposed slot move + rationale (3 min): impact on product latency and hiring velocity (Maya)
3) Finance ask (2 min): budget conversion (Priya)
4) Decision & next steps (3 min)

Notes for 1:1s this week:
- With Eng VP (10 min): confirm priority, ask for quick approval channel for urgent headcount moves.
- With Hiring Manager (15 min): alignment on C2 offer comp band, start date constraints, onboarding plan.

Misc links & refs (copy here so I don't lose):
- Headcount plan Q2 2026 (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Headcount+Plan+Q2+2026
- Req HIRE-321 - serving-runtime SWE (jira): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HIRE-321
- Interview rubric (drive): /shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/interview-rubric

Next edits: turn this into a one-pager for the exec ask after Finance confirms numbers.
